notes: Translated dataManagementExpA.do / dataManagementExpB.do (Qualtrics CSV import, price-list switching-point and multi-switch logic incl. Stata missing-value semantics and the merge that keeps the fine-list multi_switch flags, task renumbering/pairing, amount_precise, +0.1 midpoint) and the Table 4 (testScores) and Table 7 (finComp) regressions of analysis.do into R/fixest; SEs clustered by subject. Attempts 1-2 were exploratory (CSV structure; embedded newlines in ExpB Qualtrics exports) and printed no RESULT lines. ExpB follows the do-file literally, including 'drop if _n == 1' after dropping the two Qualtrics header rows. The final run was the first scored run; it was not compared-and-revised, and all 13 values agree with the claims to the reported precision (N = 215, 348, 4550). Stata stores generated variables as float while R uses double; this has no effect at 3 decimals.
